svg.title: Informatica MCP architecture
svg.desc: Claude Desktop connects over an SSH stdio bridge to an EC2 box running the MCP server and a scheduled monitor, which share one REST client to reach Informatica IDMC APIs; the monitor posts failure alerts to Slack channels and writes a failure ledger.
svg.text: PULL = you ask in Claude Desktop · PUSH = timer runs on its own
PULL — interactive, only during a chat
